item.title: Project handover
item.description: Practise passing responsibility to a new team, recording what still needs attention, and confirming that the team is ready to take over.

children.definition: The process of giving another person or team responsibility for work and the information they need to continue it.
children.example: During the handover, the outgoing team showed the new coordinators how to update the installation schedule.

children.definition: Responsibility for making decisions about a piece of work and ensuring that it is completed or maintained.
children.example: The billing team took ownership of the monthly reconciliation after the finance system went live.
children.translation_ru: ответственность за решения по работе, её выполнение или дальнейшее ведение
children.translation_uz: ishga oid qarorlar, ishning bajarilishi yoki davom ettirilishi uchun javobgarlik

children.definition: To give a specific task or duty to a person or team.
children.example: Before the visit ended, Mei assigned the task of checking the equipment inventory to the new coordinator.
collocations: assign a ticket to an engineer

children.definition: Waiting for a decision, response, or action before it can be completed.
children.example: The supplier's request for weekend access is still pending because the security team has yet to approve it.
children.translation_uz: hali javob berilmagan, qaror chiqmagan yoki kerakli ish bajarilmagan

children.definition: Dealt with successfully so that the problem no longer requires action.
children.example: The support lead marked the login issue as resolved after staff confirmed they could sign in again.

children.definition: The act of referring an issue to someone with greater authority to decide what to do about it.
children.example: The delay required escalation to the programme director because the project team could not approve extra spending.
children.translation_ru: передача вопроса на более высокий уровень
children.translation_uz: masalani qaror qabul qilish vakolati yuqoriroq boʻlgan shaxsga koʻrib chiqish uchun topshirish

children.definition: Intended for use during a limited period while a lasting arrangement is being prepared.
children.example: As an interim measure, the warehouse team will record returns on paper until the new scanner is installed.

children.definition: Settled or completed, with no further changes expected.
children.example: Once the project sponsor accepted the revisions, Nina uploaded the final version of the training guide.

children.definition: To make a record of an event, issue, or request in a system used to track it.
children.example: Please log any keys that are missing from the cabinet before the new shift supervisor takes over.

children.definition: A different way to complete a task despite a problem, without fixing the problem itself.
children.example: The handover notes explain a workaround for the broken export button that uses the reporting menu to download the file.

children.definition: A task, resource, or condition that other work relies on in order to proceed.
children.example: Access to the supplier portal is a dependency for the stock count because the team needs the latest delivery records.
children.translation_ru: задача, ресурс или условие, без которых другая работа не может продолжаться
children.translation_uz: boshqa ishni davom ettirish uchun zarur boʻlgan vazifa, resurs yoki shart

children.definition: The state of being sufficiently prepared to begin an activity or take on a responsibility.
children.example: The practice shift helped the supervisor assess the team's readiness to handle evening calls on its own.

children.definition: To establish that something is true, correct, or working as intended by checking it.
children.example: Before transferring the archive, Rosa verified that the receiving team could open the encrypted files.
children.translation_ru: проверять и подтверждать правильность или работоспособность
children.translation_uz: tekshirib, toʻgʻri ekaniga yoki ishlashiga ishonch hosil qilmoq

children.definition: Formal approval from an authorised person that allows work to be accepted or to move to the next stage.
children.example: The lab could reopen as soon as the manager gave formal sign-off on the safety checks.
